decisions.reason: The product showed an early positive signal through an award, fits existing geothermal capabilities, and for a large established supplier its option value still exceeds the likely low carrying cost.
As a close complement to the firm's geothermal offer, it likely remains worth keeping while market adoption is still uncertain and the incremental cost of carrying it is limited.

Although a multi-model surface-technology line is somewhat costlier to maintain, it supports the geothermal system portfolio and the firm is likely to preserve that option absent clear negative evidence.
A fire-protection steel profile system is close to the core business, technically credible for this firm, and likely worth retaining because uncertainty remains while carrying costs are manageable.
The slim steel profile system is adjacent to the established profile business, so the firm would likely keep it on the market as a relatively low-cost option until demand becomes clearer.

This decorative surface system is somewhat more discretionary and differentiation-driven than the other launches, but it still builds on existing capabilities and is likely to be kept unless uptake proves weak.
